title: Additive character of a finite sum
statement: Let $A$ be an additive commutative monoid, let $M$ be a commutative monoid, and let $\chi:A\to M$ be an additive character. For every finite set $s$ and every family $(a_i)_{i\in\iota}$ in $A$, $\chi\bigl(\sum_{i\in s}a_i\bigr)=\prod_{i\in s}\chi(a_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a finite subset of the index type $\iota$
$f$ assigns an element of $A$ to each index
